items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: Clyde was off and on. Clyde was there -- low key -- quiet like me...

ctx.x: Who stayed with you the longest? Clyde Hart was your regular piano player, right.
I think Jimmy Butts, bass player. Clyde was off and on. Clyde was there -- low key -- quiet like me...
Do you remember Hot Lips Page much?
